executiveSummary: Five arrangements carry the group's outsourced dependencies, and two of them we cannot yet explain. The plant historian runs on Contoso and has never been exercised as an exit, which is the single dependency that stops both production lines. Two further arrangements support systems nobody has traced to a business workflow, so we are carrying them without being able to say what they hold up.

arrangements.VA-001: Production hosting for the plant historian. A day of lost output is roughly a week of aftermarket margin, and the exit strategy has been written but never exercised — so the plan to leave is a document, not a demonstrated capability. The assessment is also past its annual cadence.
arrangements.VA-002: CRM hosting. The dependency traces to a system the business calls critical, but the arrangement owner has assigned a lower level on the basis that renewals continue offline for a fortnight. That disagreement is recorded rather than resolved: the trace and the owner are looking at different things, and both are on the page.
arrangements.VA-003: The marketing attribution sandbox supports nothing we have declared, so its criticality is untraced rather than low. A fourth party was introduced into its chain in June without notice, which is the kind of change a low-criticality arrangement has no cadence to catch.
arrangements.VA-005: Replacement warehouse routing, opened when the Tailspin arrangement was retired in March. The predecessor's data return and deletion are closed and recorded against it. This one has not yet been traced to a workflow.

opportunities.text: A tested exit on the plant historian is what makes the Dublin renewal negotiable: today the supplier knows it holds the group's single production dependency and that we have never demonstrated leaving.
opportunities.cites: goal:Close the Dublin authorisation year without a supervisory finding

decisions.text: Name an owner for the two untraced arrangements and have them declare what each one supports, so the next review can size them.

Asks were DROPPED, never re-pitched from board to management to get under the number — assemble_pack.py:485 names that failure and it would be the dishonest way to hit five. ——— THIS SECTION: Both vendor board asks dropped because THE THROUGH-LINE ALREADY ASKS THE QUESTION THEY ARE INSTANCES OF — whether third-party risk is a programme with an owner and a budget or a set of individual acceptances.
